name: Pinilla del Valle (Spain)
description: Divided diagonally from the upper hoist to the lower fly, white above and red below, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Pinilla del Valle (a pine on white and a chalice and stars on blue above waves).
history: Pinilla del Valle adopted its arms and flag on 29 March 2001, published in the Boletín Oficial de la Comunidad de Madrid on 3 August 2001; the flag is of proportions 2/3, a cloth divided diagonally from the upper hoist to the lower fly, white above.

features.role: Pinilla del Valle arms — pine on white, chalice and stars on blue above waves
